query: select n.nspname as schema_name, p.proname as function_name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments, pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as return_type from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where p.proname in ('current_company_id','current_user_company_id') and n.nspname in ('public','auth') order by n.nspname, p.proname limit 20
